name: OnePM
description: OnePM tasks as an OpenClaw channel for a project agent

onepm.label: OnePM
onepm.description: A OnePM project agent: its tasks are group chats.

url.label: OnePM address
url.help: Only for a self-hosted instance, e.g. https://onepm.example.com (no /api). Leave empty for https://onepm.tabsystems.tech

agentKey.label: Agent key
agentKey.help: The key shown when the agent was created or re-keyed

allowFrom.label: Allowed OnePM user ids
allowFrom.help: Only these people reach the agent; copy an id from the profile menu or the members list

requireMention.label: Require a mention
requireMention.help: On: only mentions, assignments and comments that mention the agent. Off: every comment on its tasks
